title: Project: modeling real-world objects as classes

objectives.text: Model a described real-world entity as a class with private fields, a constructor and behavior methods
Enforce the entity's rules in its constructor and methods so that an invalid object cannot be created
Make the brief's public tests pass with mvn -q -o test
